dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Never thought you'd come back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're still here?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Haha, yeah, I've reported everything I discovered to the Akademiya and applied for a new project...

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Now, I'm going to figure out what on earth happened here...

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Mm, this will add a nice footnote to my historical research.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Don't worry about my safety. The General Mahamatra's keeping an eye out for us. He's promised to provide abundant supplies and protection for the researchers sent here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about a round of Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Haha, a fellow player, huh? Lucky me!

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: I have three decks here. Take a look. Which one do you want to challenge? Just for the record, I'm pretty good at this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Safe travels!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Historical research...?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Yeah, why do you look so surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: The legend of the God King is part of history, Parvezravan's family affairs are part of history... and so is the mysterious tragedy of the Tanit.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: To put it simply, think about these questions: How do we piece together the fragmented truth?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: What purpose did the record-keeper hold when they wrote down those words? What were they thinking?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: ...All of them are history.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Did I find anything? Hmm... How about a remaining belief in the Goddess of Flowers? Eh, I'm afraid whatever is left of that belief has been wiped out now — it's gone for good.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: And... I found many books smuggled out of the Akademiya. The amount is very huge if I do say so.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Some of which are completely foreign to me... Uh, for instance... there are books about "films." What did they want these for?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: But apparently, we were wrong to presume that the desert folks were illiterate fools who would turn their noses up at knowledge... They were truly extraordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with dark-colored stains on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with blade marks on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with claw marks on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'll pass...

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Ah... Okay, we'll play next time when you're in the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with dark-colored stains on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with blade marks on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Challenge the deck with claw marks on its card box...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'll pass...

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Ah... Okay, we'll play next time when you're in the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Haha, then let's begin! Let's see... I have three decks here. What do you think, which one do you want to challenge? For the record, I'm really good at this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm not in the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Ah... Mm, I understand. My apologies... Take care.
